text:
auditor_ramona: Hi all  quick prep for tomorrow's SOC2/ISO spotlight. We need an evidence bundle showing: all RBAC changes (last 90 days), one end-to-end chainproof (PR -> approval -> CI -> kube-apiserver audit entry -> KMS event), service-account deprovs with token revocation proof, and vuln-ticket crosswalk. Can you confirm scope and drop ETA?

eli_sec: We can assemble that. Prefer a compact bundle: rolebinding_changes.csv, chainproof/example/, kms_events.csv (AWS + Azure), sa_deprov.csv, control_mapping.md, chain-of-custody.txt, README.md. Target EOD PST.

zara_oncall: I'll produce the RBAC delta CSV by diffing infra repo and matching PR metadata. CSV cols: pr_id, author, approver, cluster, binding, principals_added, principals_removed, jira_or_na, short_reason. ETA 17:30 PST.

peter_infra: For kube audit I'm extracting apiserver audit snippets with this Splunk query: 

```splunk
index=k8s_audit ("RoleBinding" OR "ClusterRoleBinding") | where _time>=relative_time(now(), "-90d@d") | table _time user verb objectRef.name objectRef.namespace annotations.pr_id requestID | sort 0 _time
```

peter_infra: For KMS I will include both AWS CloudTrail (Athena on parquet) and Azure Monitor logs for Key Vault. Athena example: 

```sql
SELECT eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.principalId, requestParameters.keyId FROM cloudtrail_parquet WHERE eventName IN ('GenerateDataKey','Decrypt','Encrypt') AND eventTime >= date_add('day', -90, current_date)
```

peter_infra: Azure KeyVault filter (Kusto): 

"AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceType == 'VAULTS' and (OperationName has 'Encrypt' or OperationName has 'Decrypt') and TimeGenerated >= ago(90d) | project TimeGenerated, OperationName, Caller, KeyName"

eli_sec: Important: auditor asked for one example where PR approval timestamp matches the kube-audit requestID timestamp and a KMS event. Please include PR URL + screenshot showing the approver and timestamp. Also include ISO8601 timezones in all exports.

zara_oncall: I'll tag rows that map to vuln tickets. One recent change was from JIRA SEC-5209 (privilege reduction after triage) I'll add the ticket link and a 2-line remediation summary. Other non-vuln changes will be N/A.

auditor_ramona: Also need evidence that service accounts removed are no longer active: include last_auth_iso and revocation_event_id (or key_deletion_id) and the auth-service logs showing token invalidation.

peter_infra: For service-account deprov I'll pull auth-telemetry and IAM change events. Example Kusto for Azure AD token revocation events: 

"AuditLogs | where ActivityDisplayName == 'RevokeSignInSessions' and TargetResources contains 'servicePrincipal' and TimeGenerated >= ago(90d)"

eli_sec: We'll produce a minimal timeline.csv with columns: event_time_iso, component, actor, action, evidence_path to make correlation easy. Also include chain-of-custody.txt listing who packaged the zip and MD5 checksum.

evidence-agent: evidence-uploaded evidence-bucket/engsec/5961234567_evidence_v1.zip (expires in 48h) :package:

zara_oncall: Uploaded bundle link: https://evidence.redwood.example/signed/5961234567_drop (valid 48h). Contents: rolebinding_changes.csv, chainproof/example/{pr_screenshot.png,ci_pipeline.log,kube_audit_snippet.txt,kms_event_row.csv}, kms_events.csv (aws_azure), sa_deprov.csv, timeline.csv, control_mapping.md, chain-of-custody.txt, README.md.

auditor_ramona: Thanks. A couple of quick asks before I start review: 1) ensure all timestamps include timezone (UTC offset), 2) confirm the PR screenshot shows the approver name and timestamp, 3) make sure the kube audit snippet includes the requestID we can match to CI logs.

peter_infra: Confirmed on all three. The chainproof example PR is PR#8123, approver "maria.platform" at 2026-03-22T14:12:05-07:00 and the kube audit requestID is 9b2f1c4a-... which appears in the pipeline log. KMS event row shows a Decrypt by principal service-account@redwood.example at 2026-03-22T14:12:07-07:00.

eli_sec: README.md lists eli_sec as primary contact and zara_oncall as backup; README also documents filenames and how to reproduce correlation steps. control_mapping.md highlights SOC2 CC6.2 and ISO A.9.2 mappings. chain-of-custody.txt contains MD5 and packaging timestamps.

auditor_ramona: Great I'll download and spot-check the chainproof first. If I need clarifications i'll post here. Appreciate the quick turn. :thumbsup:
